summary: In commercial satellite communications, Hughes has filed for bankruptcy after its geostationary business lost ground to SpaceX’s Starlink network. In military developments, the U.S. Space Force selected 15 companies to build test and training infrastructure, tapped K2 to host satellite laser link tests, and formed a strategic defense innovation alliance between the Department of the Air Force and the Texas Space Commission. Additionally, the Air Force Research Laboratory added $11.7 million to Blue Origin's point-to-point cargo contract, while the air-launched Talon-A hypersonic vehicle achieved a double-digit flight milestone. On the civil space front, NASA delivered a navigation system for a commercial lunar relay and named Nathan Vassberg to head its Office of Safety and Mission Assurance. Internationally, Airbus and Thales secured an order to build Spain's replacement SpainSat satellite, Xona obtained spectrum approval for a satellite navigation network, and a rocket issue delayed the United Kingdom's first orbital launch attempt. In space science, observations from the James Webb Space Telescope revealed a warped structure in the TW Hydrae protoplanetary disk, while the Vera C. Rubin Observatory opened a new deep window on a famous cosmic field. Looking ahead, skywatchers and researchers should prepare for a total solar eclipse that will sweep across Greenland, Iceland, and Spain on August 12.
